args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's
rounding but round_money quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP. Use
ROUND_HALF_EVEN as the docstring and FIN-212 already specify.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `round_money` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- This PR changes `round_money` to quantize using `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching its own docstring and the FIN-212 requirement.
- Example: `2.665` now rounds to `2.66` (even) instead of `2.67` (half-up).

## Testing
- CI passed on commit `08d3cd5986` (run `ci-0001`).
